title: Point and tangent separation implies very ampleness on a curve
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, let $C$ be a proper smooth connected curve over $k$, and let $\mathcal M$ be a line bundle on $C$ [def-sc-curves] [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose that for every $k$-rational point $P$ one has $\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P))=\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M)-1$, and for every pair of $k$-rational points $P,Q$ one has $\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M(-P-Q))=\dim_k H^0(C,\mathcal M)-2$, where the twists use the divisor-degree convention of [def-sc-pic0]. Then $\mathcal M$ is very ample [def-sc-ample].
